points.heading: Bespoke strategy for every client.
points.text: Every plan starts with what's actually happening in your market — not a generic package rolled out to everyone.

points.heading: Pricing and reporting you can actually understand.
points.text: Fixed monthly pricing, no hidden line items, and reports that explain what happened instead of burying it in jargon.

points.heading: AI used where it actually helps.
points.text: Automating repetitive work like review follow-up and first-response chat — not replacing judgement on the parts that need it.

points.heading: Small by design.
points.text: You work directly with the people actually doing the work, not a rotating cast of account managers passing you up a chain.

services.heading: Core services, plus the AI tools that used to be out of reach.

howWeWork.heading: Four steps. No surprises in between.

steps.name: Discovery
steps.text: We start by understanding what's actually happening in your business — not a template intake form, an actual conversation about your goals, your customers, and what's not working yet.

steps.name: Strategy
steps.text: From there, a plan specific to your market: which services matter first, what a realistic timeline looks like, and what success actually looks like for you.

steps.name: Implementation
steps.text: SEO, your website, branding, campaigns — built and set live, with you kept in the loop rather than finding out after the fact.

steps.name: Growth
steps.text: Results get tracked, reported honestly, and the strategy adjusts as your business and your market change. This doesn't stop once the site's live.

work.heading: A look at what we build.

finalCta.heading: Ready to grow your business?
